Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet for a side-scrolling game. Image 1 is the APPROVED identity reference for Killer Kai. Preserve EXACTLY his pale cool ivory skin, tightly curly dark brown hair, black expressive eyes, cyan temple cybernetics, compact cobalt blue / steel / charcoal cyborg armor, round cyan chest light, chunky armored boots, integrated large right forearm blaster cannon with circular cyan muzzle, articulated left hand. SAME character, facial features, hair silhouette and body proportions throughout. Rough thick black ink outlines and textured colored-pencil / crayon fill, matching the reference; NOT pixel art, NOT 3D, NOT vector. All poses face RIGHT, strict side three-quarter platform-game view. Real transparent alpha canvas, no scenery, no lettering/numbers/gridlines, no shadows under feet. EXACTLY 16 complete separate body poses arranged in an EVEN 4 columns x 4 rows grid, row-major. Every pose stays fully inside its equal square cell with generous clear gutters; no overlap, no clipping, stable body size across frames. Keep curls/skin/armor consistent, barrel stays the SAME arm. Only change pose as directed. Each row is a coherent animation progression with readable motion. The sheet fills a square canvas.
ROW 1: four subtly different IDLE breathing ready stances, cannon lowered diagonally forward, feet planted. ROW 2 and ROW 3 together: eight sequential RUN cycle poses, arms and alternating legs moving clearly, first contact right foot, down, passing, up, opposite contact, down, passing, up; BOTH feet and cannon always visible. ROW 4: four JUMP phases: knees bent takeoff, rising tucked knees, airborne apex, feet extended falling to land. No energy effects on this sheet.

fx: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game projectile sprite sheet matching the rough thick ink and colored pencil texture of the reference cyborg's cyan arm cannon. EXACTLY 8 ISOLATED ENERGY PROJECTILES, evenly arranged 4 columns by 2 rows on a wide transparent alpha canvas. ALL travel to the RIGHT, cyan/azure/white energy with dark blue sketch outlines. Top row: four consecutive flight animation phases for a small compact oval cyan plasma pellet, bright white core, short tapered blue tail on LEFT, point/rounded front on RIGHT. Bottom row: four consecutive phases for a larger powerful charged plasma bolt, bright white core, saturated cyan mantle, layered electric blue jagged tail on LEFT. Pure energy shots only, NO character, no armor, no weapon, no detached cannon, no lettering, no scenery, no grid, no shadows. Entire distinct shots fit their equal square cells with wide transparent gutters; no overlap. Same dimensions for the four normal shots; same dimensions for the four charged shots, charged is about 1.6 times normal size.
